top_creatures.label: Roaming pack with a cap (category: capped group)
top_creatures.why: A pool holds a maximum count and refills one slot at a time when a member goes, so a pack never grows past its cap and does not return all at once.
top_creatures.keep: cap per group; one-slot refill; named group rather than free spawns
top_creatures.change: cap is zone data with a grace timer; packs cap at three attackers (MAX_ATTACKERS); no hard-coded counts

top_creatures.label: Mixed-member pool (category: shared cap)
top_creatures.why: The pool code is templated over member type and treats game objects differently from creatures, so nodes or chests can share a cap with monsters and set the walk density.
top_creatures.change: our member kinds and numbers as zone data

top_creatures.label: Randomised respawn window (category)
top_creatures.why: Each spawn record draws its respawn time between a minimum and a maximum, so a pack does not return on the same beat.
